Bengaluru Tech Summit Focuses on AI and Semiconductors

The Bengaluru Tech Summit featured artificial intelligence and semiconductor manufacturing as central themes. Karnataka aims to become a global hub for AI and deep technology, with Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar stating this ambition. The state has attracted 43% of India's tech investments in the past nine months, according to Priyank Kharge. Karnataka also signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with five firms to enhance its AI skill training ecosystem.
